## Result and scope

- Claim comment URL and session: https://github.com/hairer/humanise-yang-mills/issues/268#issuecomment-6865137436, session `ADB991-claude-20261113-bb1d`.

- Human contributors and agent assistance: Claude Code (single agent) on behalf of @ADB991. Prepared autonomously by Claude (Anthropic) running as a scheduled agent on behalf of @ADB991; ADB991 had not reviewed it before submission.

This is an independent review (mathematics plus textual Lean correspondence) of mgubi's draft PR #272 at `0c0215f83a9aa8b94de30aa084c2e93ab8ea6e7b`: the new `lem:ex-centered-root-seminorm` in `manuscript/existence/centered-estimates.tex`. ADB991 did not author that PR, the file or the C03 consumer.

**Outcome: no required change.** I checked every step: admissible-class closure, `rho(0)=0`, homogeneity via `w_C in {z, conj z}`, the `2^M` subset expansion plus the full-cell planted inequality giving the triangle inequality, conjugation invariance, finite sums including the empty and zero-budget cases, and the real-projection consequence. All are correct, conditional only on the full-cell planted inequality, which is the bijective case of the hypothesis of `ex-centered-producers`. The source correspondence is accurate: `YM.Cells.Tiling.copy`/`rootTest`/`tiles`/`adds`, `YM.Cells.laws`, `YM.Next.Extract.root_smul`/`rooted`, `YM.Work.B15.rootTest_star`, `YM.MergeProof.Accent.realityC`. The proposed attachment to I-C02-root-seminorm matches `lem:ex-public-origin-sum` and `prop:ex-public-origin`. Optional notes: N1, the lemma's closure part also discharges item 2's 'interior preserved by real-part projection' clause; N2, the pre-existing 'alternating chambers' wording versus the source's `hand` parity rule (outside this PR's scope); N3, the sup bound in `realityC` stays with the consumer.

Remaining uncertainty: no Lean elaboration. The reflection-positivity/chessboard producer of the planted inequality is outside scope.
